items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And was there anybody else in Chris Kelly's band? ... Mealy Barnes played clarinet. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Uh huh.

ctx.x: Yeah, Eddie played bass and Lawrence played the banjo. Yeah. Let's see.
And was there anybody else in Chris Kelly's band? I started to ask you a minute ago if you remembered anybody else who played clarinet or? Mealy Barnes played clarinet. Mealy Barnes.
